actions: Add `wt-session.mjs cleanup [--apply]` (dry-run default): for each REGISTERED managed worktree, remove only if the path resolves under the managed worktree root AND branch matches ^wt/ and the worktree is clean and (branch merged into main OR gone); for each registered temp dir, remove only if under the allowlist (/tmp/csm-*, /tmp/opencode/csm-*) and not the current session dir.

Safety: refuse and log (trace) any target that does not resolve under the managed root/allowlist; never --force unless the path was verified under the managed root; skip main checkout and foreign/detached worktrees; idempotent.

Add tests/wt-session-cleanup.test.mjs (fixtures under a temp root): --dry-run deletes nothing; --apply removes an eligible managed worktree + an allowlisted temp dir; a foreign path is refused and not removed.
